Detail: Staff enter the customer a single time. Every later stage carries this record forward. No second form and no retyping.
Rules: Customer information is entered once. A status change must never create another customer record.

Feature: Enquiry is the first pipeline stage
Detail: A new enquiry is the start of one job that stays with the customer from start to finish.
Fields and data: Job or customer status, date and time, acting user
Rules: Each stage is stored with date, time, acting user and audit history.

Feature: Status colour for a new enquiry
Detail: New or Enquiry shows as grey on the colour-coded status bar.
Rules: Colour is controlled centrally by Admin, not chosen by each member of staff.

Feature: Search an existing customer before creating one
Detail: Staff can find an existing person instead of typing them again.
Fields and data: Search by customer name, phone, address, job number, quote number or invoice number
Rules: If the customer is already known, the next page must be pre-filled.

Feature: Add a searched product into the enquiry
Detail: From the sales screen, staff search a product and drop it onto the enquiry without retyping the product.
Fields and data: Product name, SKU, category, variant, colour, size, keyword
Rules: Result shows approved selling price, minimum allowed price, stock and variant location. Supplier cost and actual margin are never shown to Admin or User.

Detail: User role has sales and front-line access and can create enquiries inside the allowed price limits.
Rules: Server and API checks enforce this. Hiding a field on the screen is not enough.

Feature: Book the appointment from the customer
Detail: Appointment uses the customer record automatically. Staff do not type the customer or address again.
Fields and data: Date, time, purpose, assigned staff, notes
Rules: Inherits customer and job address.

Detail: The agreed pipeline stage after Enquiry is Measurement Booking.
Fields and data: Booking type, date and time, assigned staff, location or address, notes, status, customer and job reference
Rules: Booking record is stored against the job.

Detail: Creating a measurement booking creates one linked Google Calendar event.
Fields and data: Google Calendar event ID stored on the booking
Rules: Reschedule and cancel update that same event. They must not create a second event.

Detail: A change updates the ERP booking and Google Calendar together.
Fields and data: New date, time, staff, address, notes
Rules: Then the configured internal reminder and customer reminder run.

Detail: Booking confirmations and reminders may be sent to the customer.
Rules: Only explicitly configured customer events send a message.

Detail: The screen shows one large next button.
Rules: Staff should not have to decide where to go next.

Detail: Appointment status is blue.
Rules: Colour comes from the central status list.

Detail: The measurement task can be assigned to a member of staff and appears on that person's schedule.
Rules: HR scheduling is mandatory, not a later extra.

Detail: Press CONVERT TO MEASUREMENT. Customer, address and job are already filled.
Fields and data: Customer name, phone, address shown at the top
Rules: Do not ask for the customer again.

Detail: This status is for the office only. Measurement is a free service.
Rules: Selecting this status must not send the customer a message.

Detail: A simple ADD ROOM button. Save the room, then add the next room immediately.
Fields and data: Room name such as Lounge, Bedroom 1, Hall, Stairs
Rules: Rooms are not one fixed property layout.

Detail: Staff pick an area or type a custom name.
Fields and data: Living Room, Dining Room, Storage, Loft, Main Hall, Bedroom, Kitchen, Balcony, plus custom name
Rules: Each room or area is its own tab on the job.

Detail: Length and width in metres or in feet and inches.
Rules: System calculates square metres and square yards. Staff do not calculate the area.

Detail: Pick carpet, vinyl, laminate, LVT or another product from the product list.
Rules: Catalogue controls units and the calculation method.

Detail: Accessories are tick boxes, not free typing.
Rules: Chosen accessories stay attached to the correct room.

Detail: Take or upload at least 3 to 5 photos from the phone.
Rules: Photos are stored on the room and later on the job.

Detail: Notes, status, and who is responsible.
Fields and data: Notes, room status, assigned staff or fitter
Rules: Each room keeps its own measurements and notes.

Detail: The bottom of the measurement page is CREATE QUOTATION. The stage button is NEXT: CREATE QUOTATION.
Rules: Quotation must open with these rooms already in it.

Detail: Measurement status is purple.
Rules: Central colour list.

Feature: Quotation is built from the measurement
Detail: Press CREATE QUOTATION. Staff must not type the rooms again. Every measured room appears on its own.
Rules: If rooms are already measured, the quotation already contains those rooms.

Detail: Each room has its own subtotal.
Rules: Accessories sit against the correct room.

Detail: Labour and fitting are calculated from Admin price rules.
Rules: Staff do not type the labour price by hand unless a permitted adjustment exists.

Detail: The page calculates the whole-job subtotal, discount, VAT and delivery where they apply.
Rules: VAT and document settings are configurable by Admin.

Detail: Show total price, deposit required and balance due.
Rules: Deposit rules are configurable.

Detail: Internal cost and margin are visible only to authorised users.
Rules: Super Admin only, because margin uses actual supplier cost. Admin and User must not see it.

Detail: Three actions, no extra navigation.
Fields and data: SAVE DRAFT, SEND QUOTE, ACCEPT / CREATE JOB
Rules: Draft and sent are different statuses.

Detail: Draft is light grey. Sent is amber.
Rules: Central colour list.

Detail: Super Admin sets the minimum selling threshold.
Fields and data: Minimum allowed selling price on each line
Rules: If a line is below the threshold, block save and send, unless Super Admin explicitly overrides it. Log the user, old price, new price, time and reason.

Feature: Add a searched product to the quote
Detail: A product found in search can be added straight onto the quotation.
Fields and data: Product, variant, approved selling price, minimum price, stock
Rules: No retyping of the product. No supplier cost on screen for Admin or User.

Detail: Price changes keep an audit trail.
Fields and data: Old price, new price, user, time
Rules: An accepted quotation keeps the commercial values it had when it was accepted, even if prices change later.

Detail: The stage button is NEXT: ACCEPT AND CREATE JOB.
Rules: Acceptance is the door into the job.

Feature: Accept and create the job in one click
Detail: Do not make staff create a job by hand. Ask: Convert this quotation into a job? On Yes, the job is created.
Rules: Everything is copied by reference. No second entry of customer, rooms, products or prices.

Feature: What is copied onto the job
Detail: The job opens already holding the accepted quote.
Fields and data: Customer and address, all rooms and measurements, products and quantities, accessories, prices and the approved quote version, deposit and payment information, notes and photos, fitting and delivery requirements
Rules: One job number stays with the customer from start to finish.

Detail: In the agreed pipeline this stage is Customer Approval, after Quotation and before Advance Received.
Rules: Status colour for Accepted is green.

Detail: The job uses the approved quote version.
Rules: Later catalogue price changes do not rewrite the accepted commercial values.

Detail: Staff record the deposit. They do not re-enter the job.
Rules: When the required deposit conditions are met, the job becomes confirmed. Status colour for Deposit Pending is orange. Confirmed is teal.

Detail: The advance is an invoice and payment record, not a note.
Fields and data: Invoice amount, due date, payment status, payment date, method, reference, remaining balance
Rules: Remaining balance is always visible.

Detail: Due and overdue reminders are created and the history is kept on the customer and job.
Fields and data: Reminder date, who followed up, outcome
Rules: Staff can see what has already been done.

Detail: Outstanding customer balances and overdue payments are visible to authorised staff.
Rules: Shown on the management dashboard.

Detail: After job or deposit, the button is NEXT: CHECK MATERIALS.
Rules: Deposit does not skip the material check.

Detail: The system checks required materials and accessories.
Fields and data: Required quantity against warehouse and showroom stock
Rules: Available stock is reserved. If stock is short, the item is flagged for purchasing. Status colour for Materials Pending is red. Ready to Fit is blue/green.

Detail: Every confirmed job has its own required-materials list, linked to that customer, job and booking.
Rules: A sofa and a carpet on the same job are tracked as separate items.

Detail: If an item is not available, short, or custom-made, create a procurement requirement.
Fields and data: Supplier, quantity, required-by date, expected arrival, purchase or order reference, status
Rules: Statuses: In Stock, To Order, Ordered, Part Received, Received/Ready, Delayed, Cancelled.

Detail: If an item is still not ordered or not received, or the supplier date puts the fitting at risk, raise an internal reminder before the fitting date.
Fields and data: Fitting date, item status, expected arrival
Rules: The job is marked at risk for the dashboard.

Detail: After Advance Received, the agreed pipeline moves to Production, then Fitting Booking.
Rules: Production is internal progress on the same job number.

Feature: Fast stock lookup while talking to the customer
Detail: Search still works from the job.
Fields and data: Name, SKU, category, variant, colour, size, keyword, stock, location, selling price, minimum price
Rules: Supplier invoice cost stays hidden from Admin and User.

Detail: Press BOOK FITTING. Job details are already on the booking.
Fields and data: Date, time, assigned fitter, address, notes
Rules: Creates a linked Google Calendar event and stores the event ID.

Detail: Where the job is a delivery rather than a fit, press BOOK DELIVERY.
Rules: Same booking record shape: type, date, staff, location, notes, status.

Detail: Changing the booking updates the ERP and the same Google Calendar event.
Rules: No duplicate calendar events.

Detail: Fitting appointments can send the configured confirmation or reminder.
Rules: Measurement Completed still does not send a message. Fitting booking can.

Detail: Ready to Fit shows NEXT: BOOK FITTING. Delivery Required shows NEXT: BOOK DELIVERY.
Rules: One next action only.

Detail: Fitting Booked is blue. Fitting Today is yellow. Fitting Complete is green. Delivery Booked is blue. Delivery Complete is green.
Rules: Central colour list.

Detail: The job page shows the fitting or delivery date and the assigned staff.
Rules: Also shown on that person's schedule.

Detail: The job page shows whether materials are ready before the fitter goes out.
Rules: Do not treat the job as ready while a required item is still To Order or Delayed.

Detail: The fitter or driver completes a checklist.
Rules: This is the completion step, not a new job.

Detail: Staff upload the required step and completion photos before the room or the job can be marked complete.
Fields and data: Photos by stage, per room or area
Rules: An authorised override is the only way past a missing required photo.

Detail: The fitter opens the same job on the phone, takes before and after photos, and the customer signs.
Rules: Photos stay attached to this job number.

Detail: Final completion captures the customer's acknowledgement.
Fields and data: Customer name, signature, date and time, optional comments
Rules: The job cannot close its work side without this, unless an authorised override exists.

Detail: Fitting Complete and Delivery Complete are green.
Rules: Issue or snag is red.

Detail: When the work is completed, the button is NEXT: COLLECT BALANCE.
Rules: Completion does not itself mean the job is paid.

Detail: Payment and the invoice update automatically. The outstanding balance is always on the job.
Rules: The invoice is generated from the accepted quotation plus approved variations plus payments.

Detail: Final outstanding balance is calculated after the advance and any credits.
Fields and data: Final invoice, payment record, remaining balance
Rules: Reminders continue until the balance is settled.

Detail: Balance Pending is orange. Fully Paid is dark green.
Rules: Payment updates the same job. It does not create another record.

Feature: Next action when the work is done but money is open
Detail: Completed shows NEXT: COLLECT BALANCE. Paid and Complete shows NEXT: CLOSE JOB.
Rules: Both work-complete and fully-paid are required before close.

Detail: Fully paid and work completed. The job becomes CLOSED.
Rules: Closed is black on the status bar.

Detail: A problem keeps the job open and visible.
Rules: Colour is red. Closing is not available while a snag is unresolved.

Detail: The job page shows the timeline underneath the progress bar.
Fields and data: Every document, photo, payment and action
Rules: Progress bar order: Appointment, Measure, Quote, Accepted, Deposit, Material, Fitting or Delivery, Complete, Balance, Closed. The addendum names the same journey as Enquiry, Measurement Booking, Measurement Completed, Quotation, Customer Approval, Advance Received, Production, Fitting Booking, Fitting, Final Payment, Completed.

Detail: Super Admin, Admin and User. Each person sees only the functions for their role.
Rules: Admin controls staff permissions.

Detail: Full access. The only role that can view supplier invoices and actual product cost.
Fields and data: Supplier invoice, actual cost, margin, profit
Rules: Can set the minimum selling price and manage permissions.

Detail: Runs customers, jobs, bookings, staff, supplier orders, payments and permitted reports.
Rules: Must not see supplier invoice or actual product cost.

Detail: Sales access. Search products and stock, see the approved selling price and the minimum allowed price, create enquiries, bookings and quotes inside the limits.
Rules: Must not see supplier cost or supplier invoice.

Feature: Permission is checked on the server
Detail: A hidden field on the screen is not a control.
Rules: Admin and User cannot retrieve supplier cost through the screen or the API.

Detail: Below the Super Admin minimum, save and send are blocked unless Super Admin overrides.
Fields and data: User, old price, new price, time, reason
Rules: The override is written to the audit log.

Detail: Admin maintains cost prices and selling prices. The product catalogue controls units and calculation methods.
Fields and data: Cost price, selling price, unit, calculation method
Rules: Cost prices are Super Admin data. Selling prices are what Admin and User may see.

Detail: Deposit rules, VAT, document settings, statuses and colours are configurable and centrally controlled.
Rules: Staff do not invent their own status names or colours.

Detail: Fast search on the sales and CRM screen.
Fields and data: Name, SKU, category, variant, colour, size, keyword
Rules: Shows approved selling price, minimum price, stock, availability, variant and location.

Detail: The supplier record shows what is owed.
Fields and data: Invoices or orders, invoice total, amount paid, outstanding balance, due date, due or overdue, payment references
Rules: Partial payments are supported and payment history is kept.

Detail: Supplier outstanding balances appear for authorised users.
Rules: This is management information, separate from the customer selling price.

Detail: HR is mandatory.
Fields and data: Name, contact, role, status, start date, permissions
Rules: Not a later phase.

Detail: Payroll records stay restricted.
Fields and data: Salary or rate, pay frequency, pay period, adjustments and deductions, amount paid, paid date, reference, history
Rules: Only Super Admin, plus a management permission if that is explicitly approved later.

Detail: Measurement, fitting and job tasks are assigned and show on the person's schedule.
Rules: Same people as the booking assigned-staff field.

Detail: The sales report separates Furniture from Carpet and Flooring, with a date filter, plus a combined total and other categories.
Rules: Furniture and Carpet/Flooring must be reportable separately.

Detail: One view for the people running the business.
Fields and data: Outstanding customer payments, supplier payables, jobs by stage, jobs at risk because materials are missing, upcoming measurement and fitting bookings, low stock and out of stock
Rules: Profit and margin reports are Super Admin only.

Detail: Moving a job to Measurement Completed does not create a customer notification.
Rules: Pass only when this condition is true.

Detail: Create, reschedule and cancel of a measurement or fitting booking updates the same Google Calendar event and does not make a duplicate.
Rules: Pass only when this condition is true.

Detail: Advance and final balances show reminder history and overdue status.
Rules: Pass only when this condition is true.

Detail: A short or custom material creates a procurement requirement linked to the job and an alert before fitting.
Rules: Pass only when this condition is true.

Detail: Admin and User cannot retrieve supplier cost from the screen or the API, and cannot sell below the threshold without a Super Admin override.
Rules: Pass only when this condition is true.

Detail: A user can search a product or variant and see the permitted price and the stock.
Rules: Pass only when this condition is true.

Detail: More than one room can store staged work photos. Completion requires the required photos and the customer acknowledgement.
Rules: Pass only when this condition is true.

Detail: The supplier shows invoice total, amount paid, outstanding balance, due or overdue status and partial payments.
Rules: Pass only when this condition is true.

Detail: An authorised user can maintain salary, payroll and staff schedules.
Rules: Pass only when this condition is true.

Detail: Furniture sales and Carpet/Flooring sales can be reported separately for a date range.
Rules: Pass only when this condition is true.

Detail: From Mr Smith through appointment, Lounge 5m x 4m, Bedroom 4m x 3m, quote, accept, deposit, materials, fitting, photos, signature, balance and close, staff never retype the customer, address, rooms or prices.
Rules: Pass only when this condition is true.

Detail: Every stage shows one obvious next button and the job page shows one next action, the balance, material readiness, the fitting or delivery date, the assigned staff, and the history.
Rules: Pass only when this condition is true.

Detail: The same screens work on a phone, a tablet and a desktop.
Rules: A new employee should be able to learn the basic process in a few minutes.

Feature: No accounts language on the shop floor
Detail: Normal staff do not see accounting or database terms.
Rules: Dropdowns, tick boxes, auto-fill and defaults wherever a typed answer can be avoided.

Detail: Back, Save and Next keep what was entered. Drafts autosave.
Rules: Staff never enter the same customer, address or job information twice.

Detail: Build the one-click workflow first. Then calculations, colour and status, mobile use, financial and stock control, reports, and integrations.
Rules: The CRM is one workflow. It is not a set of separate forms.

Detail: Every button that moves the job forward reuses data that is already stored.
Rules: If the job is complete, the invoice already knows the job total.
